title: AI fuels more than half of cybercrime in Africa as scams surge – Interpol
summary: Interpol reports that AI now drives over half of cybercrime in Africa, with scams surging due to generative AI enabling sophisticated phishing, deepfakes, and automated fraud. The report highlights the growing misuse of AI by criminals, outpacing defensive measures and posing significant challenges for law enforcement and cybersecurity across the continent.
